key_points.evidence_quote: Both episodes feature in common A6 and Z general partner in Fintech, Alex Rampel, who also wrote about how small businesses depend on the stimulus package, and the stimulus package will depend on fintech, which you can find at A6NZ.com slash pandemic stimulus.

thesis: The episode argues that government shutdowns due to the pandemic function as a form of 'eminent domain' over business solvency and revenue, effectively seizing the ability of small businesses to operate without direct financial compensation. It further posits that Federal Reserve monetary policy tools, such as lowering interest rates and providing liquidity, are insufficient to help these businesses because they cannot address the lack of customer demand caused by public health restrictions.
